text: {"lessons":["I’ve often sold winners quickly to lock in gains, then sometimes bought them back at higher prices; I should base decisions on future prospects, not the pleasure of realizing a gain.","Treating each stock as a separate account can make my purchase price feel like a target; it is only a reference point, not a reason to hold or sell.","Frequent trading can interrupt a sound long-term plan. I should pause before acting and consider the whole portfolio’s risk, diversification, and goals."]}
